diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the default/standard windows (Tuesday 0800-1200 for vehicle recovery and Wednesday 1300-1600 for preventive maintenance) using only shared facts S1-S4. The model is able to make correct decisions without accessing the hidden information in PF1 or PF2, as the standard schedule matches the expected outcome in every instance.

fix_instructions: To force reliance on hidden information, change the default/publicly available schedule so that it conflicts with the required decision. For example, set the public vehicle recovery window to a time that does not match the evaluator's availability in PF1, forcing the agent to use PF1 to identify the correct Wednesday window.
